author: PlayStation
description:
Ys X: Proud Nordics is finally here! Experience the definitive edition of this critically-acclaimed RPG on PlayStation®5 today!

After a tense encounter at sea, the young red-haired adventurer Adol and the proud Norman Karja find themselves bound together by shackles of Mana, and by the looming threat of an undying horde known as the Griegr, who seek to pillage the vibrant Obelia Gulf. Aboard their ship, the Sandras, Adol and Karja gather a trusty crew of friends and allies as they go head-to-head with the Griegr in one unforgettable journey!

Stand proud for new quality-of-life improvements, locations, storylines, characters, and more! Use the new Mana Hold ability to manipulate the environment. Dive into Muspelheim for the ultimate challenge. Learn new details about Ys lore never before revealed.

All this and more in Ys X: Proud Nordics, available now!

Season 18: Act 3 sees Captain Flameheart gain a foothold in The Devil's Roar through the construction of two towering Ashen Garrisons! Should your crew be up for taking them on you'll need to scale the walls, unlock the doors and brawl your way through skeletons and traps alike, but the handsome stack of spoils and intimidating cosmetic rewards should more than justify the effort. Plus, until the end of Season 18, all Ashen Garrison vaults have the chance of containing a mega stash! Hopefully you can handle the heat, pirates...
